```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

```

```{r packages, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(phytools)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(BoSSA)

```

```{r args}

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_tree <- args[1]
input_jplace <- args[2]
input_data <- args[3]

```


```{r prepTree}

unfiltered_tree <- read.tree(input_tree)


gene_tree <- drop.tip(unfiltered_tree, unfiltered_tree$tip.label[grep("GVOG", unfiltered_tree$tip.label)])

gene_tree$tip.label <- sub("_#_.*$", "", gene_tree$tip.label)


sqrt_tree <- gene_tree

sqrt_tree$edge.length <- sqrt(gene_tree$edge.length)

lad_sqrt_tree <- ladderize(sqrt_tree)

```

```{r jplace, echo = FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=12, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}

my_jplace <- read_jplace(input_jplace)

place_table <- my_jplace$placement_positions
multiclass_table <- my_jplace$multiclass

place_name_table <- left_join(place_table, multiclass_table, by = "placement_id")

place_name_table$id <- sub(" # .*$", "", place_name_table$name)
place_name_table$acc <- sub("\\..*$", "", place_name_table$name)

lwr_table <- place_name_table |>
  group_by(name) |>
  slice_max(like_weight_ratio, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

```

```{r prepData}

gene_data <- read.table(input_data,
                        header = FALSE,
                        sep = "\t",
                        fill = TRUE,
                        row.names = 1,
                        colClasses = c("V3" = "character"))

gene_data$V9 <- sub("\\..*$", "", row.names(gene_data))

traits <- gene_data[, c(8, 2, 7), drop = FALSE]

names(traits) <- c("acc", "part", "gc")

traits$acc <- factor(traits$acc)
traits$part <- factor(traits$part)
traits$gc <- as.numeric(traits$gc)
traits$lwr <- as.numeric(lwr_table$like_weight_ratio)

part_levels <- levels(droplevels(traits$part))
acc_levels <- levels(droplevels(traits$acc))

part_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(c("#C7FFD5", "#5099D4", "#7F00B5"))(
    length(part_levels)
  ),
  part_levels
)

gc_cols <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#780000", "#B4491F", "#FFAA42", "#FFFF9C")
)(100)

acc_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(c("#C5C8FC", "#F2A285", "#088C21", "#D354DE"))(
    length(acc_levels)
  ),
  acc_levels
)

lwr_cols <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#065299", "#0D8AA6", "#C8FC92")
)(100)

```

```{r depth}

gene_data$V9 <- factor(gene_data$V9)

acc_summary <- gene_data |>
  count(V9, name = "total_reads") |>
  arrange(desc(total_reads))

tree_distances <- cophenetic.phylo(gene_tree)

min_reads <- 2
max_diam <- 0.1
min_cluster_size <- 2

keep_accs <- acc_summary |>
  filter(total_reads >= min_reads)

results_list <- list()

for (acc in keep_accs$V9) {
  
  ids <- row.names(gene_data)[gene_data$V9 == acc]
  
  if (length(ids) >= min_reads) {
    acc_distances <- tree_distances[ids, ids]
    
    hc <- hclust(as.dist(acc_distances), method = "complete")
    clusters <- cutree(hc, h = max_diam)
    total_clust <- table(clusters)
    keep_clust <- total_clust[total_clust >= min_cluster_size]
    
    if (length(keep_clust) > 0) {
      
      for (cl_id in names(keep_clust)) {
        
        clust_ids <- names(clusters[clusters == as.numeric(cl_id)])
        clust_pos <- gene_data[clust_ids, 2]
        
        n_start <- sum(clust_pos == "10", na.rm = TRUE)
        n_middle <- sum(clust_pos == "11", na.rm = TRUE)
        n_end <- sum(clust_pos == "01", na.rm = TRUE)
        
        depth_df <- data.frame(
          
          Accession = as.character(acc),
          Cluster_Count = length(clust_ids),
          Start = n_start,
          Middle = n_middle,
          End = n_end,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          
        )
        
        
        results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- depth_df
        
      }
    }
  }
}

full_df <- bind_rows(results_list) |>
    arrange(desc(Cluster_Count))

```



## Summary

#### Table 1: Total Putative PolB-related Coding Region Fragments per Accession
```{r}

acc_summary <- gene_data |>
  count(V9, name = "total_reads") |>
  arrange(desc(total_reads))

acc_summary <- acc_summary |> rename("Accession Number" = V9)
acc_summary <- acc_summary |> rename("Total Fragments" = total_reads)

knitr::kable(
  acc_summary,
  row.names = FALSE,
  align = c("l", "c")
)
```


#### <br>
## Phylogeny

#### Relatedness of Putative PolB Fragments
Due to the short length of the fragments and the high variability of the PolB gene in giant viruses, this tree should be interpreted as a general indication of the relationships between these sequences, rather than a statistically robust result.

```{r plotTree, fig.width=12, fig.height=12, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}

partials <- c(
  "00" = "Full",
  "01" = "Start",
  "10" = "End",
  "11" = "Middle"
)

plotFanTree.wTraits(
  lad_sqrt_tree,
  traits,
  ftype= "off",
  colors = list(acc_cols, part_cols, gc_cols, lwr_cols),
  part = 1,
  arc_height = 0.65,
  spacer = 0
)

legend( x = -10, y = 3,
        legend = partials[unique(traits$part)],
        lwd = 8, col = part_cols,
        title = "Part of coding region predicted",
        bty = "n",
        xjust = 0, yjust = 0,
        ncol = 2)

add.color.bar(
  20,
  cols = gc_cols,
  title = "GC content",
  lims = range(traits$gc * 100),
  digits = 2,
  prompt = FALSE,
  x = -10, y = -1,
  lwd = 8,
  outline = FALSE,
  subtitle = ""
)

add.color.bar(
  20,
  cols = lwr_cols,
  title = "Likelihood-weight ratio",
  lims = range(traits$lwr),
  digits = 2,
  prompt = FALSE,
  x = -10, y = -7,
  lwd = 8,
  outline = FALSE,
  subtitle = ""
)

```

```{r adjust}

acc_num <- length(unique(traits$acc))

leg_rows <- 5

rows <- ceiling(acc_num/leg_rows)

height <- rows

```

```{r acc_legend, fig.height=height, fig.width = 12, out.width="100%"}

par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

plot.new()

legend( x = 0, y = 1,
        legend = unique(traits$acc),
        lwd = 8, col = acc_cols,
        title = "Accession Number",
        title.adj = 0,
        bty = "n",
        xjust = 0, yjust = 1,
        ncol = leg_rows)

```
Figure 1: Putative phylogenetic tree of extracted fragments with mapped traits

#### <br>
#### Confidence of Phylogenetic Placement
When placing query sequences on a reference gene tree, there is often more than one likely location for each query sequence. This uncertainty can be represented by the likelihood weight ratio.

```{r}

ggplot(place_name_table, aes(x = like_weight_ratio, fill = acc)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Likelihood Weight Ratio",
       y = "Placement Frequency",
       fill = "Accession Number",
       main = NULL)

```

Figure 2: Likelihood weight ratio of likely locations of the fragments
